# Ditte Hammerum

Ditte Hammerum is a nurse ("sygeplejerske") who worked at Carelink psykiatri, part of Nærhospital Viborg, and served as a member of the steering group ("styregruppe") for the Danish ADHD database, a national health quality-monitoring register that tracks the assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under the age of 18 [^src1][^src2].

The ADHD database's steering group brings together senior physicians, specialist doctors, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and relatives' representatives from across Denmark to oversee data on ADHD diagnosis and treatment outcomes, including findings such as lower rates of completing the Danish school leaving exam among children with ADHD compared to the general population [^src1]. Hammerum's listed affiliation with [[carelink-psykiatri-viborg|Carelink psykiatri, Nærhospital Viborg]] appears consistently across both the 2023 and 2024 editions of the database's annual report, indicating she held this steering group role over at least two consecutive reporting cycles [^src1][^src2].

No further biographical details, claims, or timeline events are available for Ditte Hammerum in the corpus.
